plugins.name: finding-unknowns
plugins.description: Keep your own map of what you know and do not know: a four-quadrant map (KK, KU, UK, UU) before non-trivial changes, with one pause for your reply (fu:before), and what moved after the work (fu:after), plus /fu-interview and /fu-lookback. Pair it with the 127-word always-on text in CLAUDE.md.
